name: B10-0406/2026 – After § 13 – Am 39
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants in Ceuta and the need for a coordinated response to protect the EU’s external borders
part_text: 13b. Recalls that, under the 2007 agreement between Spain and Morocco and the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child, any return of an unaccompanied minor requires an individual assessment of the best interests of the child, the verification of family reunification conditions and the involvement of child protection authorities; stresses that collective returns of minors are prohibited under EU and international law;
